statements.t: We intend to use our investor relations website as a means of disclosing information about our business, our financial condition and results of operations and other matters and for complying with our disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.

We plan to continue investing in our strategic B2B, B2C, and SB offerings, with an emphasis on simplifying our business, concentrating investment on our highest-value initiatives, and building scalable infrastructure to support AI-enabled and agentic commerce use cases.
We intend to prioritize initiatives that we believe deliver the greatest long-term value for merchants while simplifying execution and strengthening our platform.

We expect to advance our growth strategy through continued product innovation, self-service and product-led offerings, and development of AI-enabled commerce solutions that address increasingly complex merchant needs.

We also intend to grow our business by acquiring new customers, expanding adoption and usage among existing customers, mitigating churn, and selectively expanding our presence in new markets, while maintaining a disciplined focus on operating efficiency, profitability, and cash flows.

Our operational and financial results have been, and will continue to be, affected by a number of factors that present significant opportunities as well as risks and challenges, including those discussed below and elsewhere in this quarterly report and in our Annual Report .

Our partner strategy is intended to enable customers to compose solutions that integrate with adjacent technology providers, including payments, fulfillment, ERP, marketing, and other categories, and may support demand generation through ecosystem-led distribution.
As our platform evolves, we believe our partner ecosystem will continue to support customer adoption and engagement while creating opportunities for sustainable growth.

We expect cost of revenue to slightly increase in absolute dollars primarily driven by hosting costs, but anticipate that cost of revenue as a percentage of revenue to remain consistent for the remaining fiscal year 2026.
We expect sales and marketing expenses to remain consistent, both in absolute dollars and as a percentage of revenue, in the near term.
We expect research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue to remain consistent as we continue to prioritize investment in our core offerings for the remaining fiscal year 2026.
We expect general and administrative expenses as a percentage of revenue to remain consistent in the near term, reflecting operational costs efficiencies.

The Company expects to incur additional restructuring charges of approximately $5.4 million to $10.9 million in connection with the 2026 Restructure, of which approximately $3.5 million to $7.5 million is expected to be recognized in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 and the remainder in fiscal 2027.

The Company expects to incur additional costs of approximately $0.8 million to $1.8 million in connection with the 2025 Restructure, of which approximately $0.5 million to $1.1 million is expected to be recognized in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026 and the remainder in fiscal 2027.
We intend to fund any repurchases under the Share Repurchase Program with existing cash and cash equivalents and cash generated from operations.
We do not have any material off-balance sheet arrangements that we expect would materially affect our liquidity and capital resources.
We will settle conversions by paying or delivering, as applicable, cash, shares of our common stock or a combination of cash and shares of our common stock, at our election.

In addition, to the extent the Company incurs subordinated indebtedness pursuant to the terms of the Indenture, it will be required to secure the 2028 Convertible Notes, subject only to prior security interests in favor of lenders under any senior secured revolving credit facility, if then outstanding.

We also do not provide guidance on Cash Flows from Operating Activities.

In addition, we have provided a target of full-year Non-GAAP operating margin of at least 20% beginning in 2027 and estimated annualized Non-GAAP operating cost reductions of $60 million to $80 million under our strategic operating plan.
